answer: Schedule the sybil test. Randomly pair each agent for rounds, half against one peer and half against another. Honest operators grow a dense, consistent graph of ties, because one keeper logging ivory updates, jade attestations, and pearl settlements cannot tell two counterparties different histories. A cloned farm fails there: its branches drift, contradict, or go quiet when paired apart. Verifiers need no identity oracle, only cross-checked transcripts, and the cost of faking coherence across many ledgers outruns any farm.
